estimand: Exploratory prediction error for finishing-phase DMI summaries of beef steers from a new experiment represented by this source; not mature beef cows on pasture.
populationBoundary: Finishing/feedlot beef steers. This experiment cannot satisfy or replace the #109 mature-beef-cow pasture DMI gate or the original #110 target.
models: Ridge(alpha=1.0) with fold-local numeric standardization and fold-local breed one-hot encoding
RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=300, min_samples_leaf=3, max_features=1.0, random_state=20261013, n_jobs=1) with fold-local breed one-hot encoding

evaluation.split: Leave-one-Project-out grouped cross-validation; Project is the five-experiment identifier, and Project+Animal is the animal identifier.
evaluation.preprocessing: Fit all encoders and scalers within each training fold only.
evaluation.reporting: Pooled out-of-fold metrics and metrics/counts for each held-out Project; compare all models on identical cases.
evaluation.tuning: None. Hyperparameters are fixed before evaluation.
evaluation.uncertainty: No calibrated confidence or prediction intervals will be reported.
limits: Only five independent experiments are available; the effective independent sample size is five trials, not 446 animals.
This is internal cross-experiment evaluation on one deposited source, not independent external validation.
ADG is a contemporaneous outcome and makes this a retrospective component prediction, not a prospective deployment model.
No mechanistic comparator is reported because the reviewed BR-CORTE equation targets growing Zebu cattle on tropical pasture, not finishing feedlot steers.
